context: Tests whether the agent uses Design-by-Contract (DbC) principles, including class invariants and the rejection of defensive programming.

checklist.name: Precondition defined
checklist.description: Explicitly defines preconditions for public methods (e.g. put, get).

checklist.name: Postcondition defined
checklist.description: Explicitly defines postconditions for public methods.

checklist.name: Class Invariant
checklist.description: Defines a class invariant that must be true for all instances of the buffer.

checklist.name: No Defensive Programming
checklist.description: Does NOT include redundant 'if' checks for things covered by the precondition in method bodies.

checklist.name: Native Assertions
checklist.description: Uses native assertions (e.g., assert) to enforce the contract.
